title: ListAvailableRegionsResponse
description: Paginated list of available cloud regions.

AvailableRegion.description: A cloud provider region available for cluster deployment.

provider.description: Cloud provider the region belongs to.

serverless.description: Whether this region supports Serverless clusters.

PaginationResponse.description: Pagination metadata included in list responses.

next.description: Token or cursor for retrieving the next page of results.

last.description: Token or cursor for the last page of results.

time.description: Server time at which the paginated query was executed.
